articles.title: While the US Navy cuts the reactor block out of its old nuclear submarines and buries it whole in a desert trench, Britain has cut 2,695 tons off a 272-foot Cold War attack submarine in a Scottish dry dock, taking one fully apart for the first time anywhere
articles.summary: The US Navy has efficiently scrapped its obsolete nuclear submarines since the 1980s. Their method involves cutting the entire reactor compartment, containing hazardous nuclear material, directly out of the submarine's hull as a single, sealed block. This streamlined process ensures safe and effective disposal of these complex military vessels, highlighting an important aspect of naval asset management.

articles.title: Halliburton (HAL) Wins Integrated Cyprus Contract. Can Broader Services Improve Returns?
articles.summary: US energy services giant Halliburton secured a multi-year contract from Italian energy firm Eni for the Cronos ultra-deepwater development offshore Cyprus. This significant award covers integrated drilling services, underscoring continued major energy exploration and production activities in the Eastern Mediterranean, a region of increasing geopolitical importance for energy resources.

articles.title: Trump's sons-linked US drone firm signs India deal to manufacture anti-drone systems months before Pakistan deal
articles.summary: An American autonomous systems company, reportedly linked to Donald Trump's sons, signed a manufacturing agreement months before finalizing a deal to sell armed drones to Pakistan. This development, highlighted from New Delhi, suggests intricate international defence transactions and potential scrutiny over the company's involvement in both manufacturing and subsequent arms sales, impacting regional security dynamics.

articles.title: RPSC successfully conducts re-test of SI-2021 exam
articles.summary: Recent headlines indicate significant international and domestic political challenges. Mark Carney's moves amid a '51st State Row' and Canada's strengthened EU ties are framed as a setback for Trump's administration.
